# `cardinality`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the size of an array or a map.
This function returns -1 for null input only if spark.sql.ansi.enabled is false and
spark.sql.legacy.sizeOfNull is true. Otherwise, it returns null for null input.
With the default settings, the function returns null for null input.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
cardinality(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `collection_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- cardinality, example 1
> SELECT cardinality(array('b', 'd', 'c', 'a'));
4
```

```sql
-- cardinality, example 2
> SELECT cardinality(map('a', 1, 'b', 2));
2
```
